name: Ayanokouji Hikaru
source: [url=/c32561]Hakuhouin Hikaru[/url] married Kousuke after graduation and had [url=/c32565]a daughter[/url] with him. She was still having an affair with the protagonist when her daughter was a child, halfway through her marriage she decided to leave [url=/c116924]Reiga[/url] to start a new life. Years later, she discovered that Reiga had become the new principal of their old high school... which her daughter now attends.
